Results.ReviewText: This is the ideal gas grill for a smaller household.  Having first used Weber grills several decades ago, it’s clear to me that Weber’s years of experience have brought refinements that make the Spirit II E-210 so sophisticated and perfect, yet so easy to use and maintain. With two burners instead of three, the opportunities for indirect heat are reduced, but with that one gets an excellent and efficient function in a grill, without a sprawling footprint.  And the 10-year warranty on the starter is so reasssuring — to know that Weber itself has such great confidence in its own product!

Results.ReviewText:
The push button ignitor would not work.  I bought this grill from Lowe's preassembled. Hooked up a tank of propane but couldnt get the burners to ignite.  To ensure I was getting fuel, I manually lit the burners with a match.  I also could visually see the spark coming from the ignitor but it simply wouldnt work. 
Rather than take the grill back, I called Weber customer support.  They were also puzzled why the grill wouldnt ignite even though there was a spark and it could be manually started with a match.
They shipped me a replacement kit for the ignitor.  I replaced the entire ignitor assembly, but it still wouldnt work.  I finally gave up and returned the grill to Lowe's for a refund.
Results.Title: Ignitor wouldn't work

Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The grill itself is very nice and holds good temperature with accurate thermometer that overall is sturdy. I am very happy with my purchase. I do have a few callouts that I wish I knew prior to buying:

• The build time is pretty rough. It approximates 4-6 hours which is very accurate. It can be built solo but certain parts are harder than others by yourself. The booklet is your classic Ikea photo based instructions. It took me about 5 hours to build it

• Only one side of the grill arms goes up and down while the other is locked in position. This to me seems like a peculiar design decision because I was hoping to drop both arms for storage. You can just unscrew it but why make it harder than it needs to be 

• The caps that go over the wheels will pop off over and over and over again. It's just cosmetic but it's maddening 

Overall I am happy with the grill and it's a major upgrade from my previous starter grill
Results.Title: Quality grill that isn't fun to build

Results.ReviewText:
I was fortunate enough to find this grill at a very low price because it had sat outside and had surface rust and scratches. With a little elbow grease I was able to clean it. 
This grill is the product of thoughtful engineering. The cast iron grill has a flat side that allows foods that frequently fall through to be cooked perfectly. The scale that holds the tank is as handy as it is accurate. The design of the grill lid and the grill box insure that the heat is not lost thus giving the cook better control when cooking. I’ve been cooking on grills for over fifty years, and this, in my opinion, is the best. 
The only negative is that it struggles to get to 600 degrees.   In view of all the positive qualities, I can live with that.
Results.Title: BEST GRILL EVER

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
